text_to_image_prompt: Adult man aged 25. Masculine elegant adult fantasy prince aged 26. Long smoky dark-brown straight layered hair reaching below shoulders with face-framing strands swept clear of eyes, deep sapphire eyes, elongated gently angular face, medium straight lips. Original low-profile dark-silver circlet with a single small smoky blue gem, thin silver drop earrings, fully clothed high-neck charcoal brocade court jacket. Calm dignified faint smile, no raised hands, all crown inside frame. Complete the original charcoal brocade high-neck court jacket as a knee-length tailored fantasy coat with subtly embroidered long back panels, matching slim trousers and black knee-high riding boots. Retain silver circlet, blue central gem and matching dangling earrings. Premium semi-realistic 2.5D/3D romance-game CG, refined sculpted facial modeling, softly expressive eyes, detailed individual hair strands, restrained skin microtexture and low sheen, dimensional fabric and metal materials. Pure opaque white background, bright soft neutral frontal key and gentle fill, no colored cast, no text labels borders watermark or UI. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
